name: Workflow 4 – Gestion des séquences et relances

parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.id as prospect_id,
  p.first_name,
  p.last_name,
  p.company,
  p.title,
  p.linkedin_url,
  p.instagram_username,
  p.platform,
  p.status,
  s.id as sequence_id,
  s.step_number,
  s.step_type,
  s.template_key,
  s.scheduled_at
FROM sequence_steps s
JOIN prospects p ON s.prospect_id = p.id
WHERE s.scheduled_at <= NOW()
  AND s.status = 'pending'
  AND p.status NOT IN ('converted', 'unsubscribed', 'do_not_contact')
ORDER BY s.scheduled_at ASC
LIMIT 10;

=UPDATE sequence_steps
SET status = 'sent', sent_at = NOW(), message_sent = '{{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.message.replace("'", "''") }}'
WHERE id = {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.sequence_id }};

-- Créer la prochaine étape si applicable
INSERT INTO sequence_steps (prospect_id, step_number, step_type, scheduled_at, status)
SELECT
  {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.prospect_id }},
  {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} + 1,
  CASE
    WHEN {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} = 1 THEN 'follow_up_1'
    WHEN {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} = 2 THEN 'follow_up_2'
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} = 1 THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '3 days'
    WHEN {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} = 2 THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  'pending'
WHERE {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} < 3
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sequence_steps
    WHERE prospect_id = {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.prospect_id }}
      AND step_number = {{ $('prepare-sequence-action').item.json.step_number }} + 1
  );
